scope: QPC elapsed fixed get_failure workload over all warmed residents. Timing includes alias coordinate generation, status/coordinate folds and raw pointer fold; identity/raw-state/setup checks are outside clocks. No callback/churn/load/rebuild timing, public-vs-internal adapter or FPS claim.
clock: QueryPerformanceCounter elapsed ticks; no process CPU accounting or overhead subtraction

source_identity.timing_scope: Elapsed time includes real GET plus coordinate/alias selection, raw status aggregation and coordinate/pointer checksum folds.

workload.coordinates: x=2*(index%16), z=2*(index/16); all selected keys prequalified; uniform73-step permutation; every32nd timed call uses packedX+32768 alias

limits: Warmed resident scoped GET plus fixed loop/checksum work, not API-only latency.
No actual callback, map churn, load, generation, rebuild, render or gameplay FPS timed.
Eight-Chunk depth-one case regresses; no blanket speedup claim.
No original-game performance comparison or statistical-significance claim.
